description: Ink-based management pane for the /sess session manager. Renders the live dashboard from docs/SESSION_MANAGER_SPEC.qmd, reflects voice-command mutations as toasts, and supports interactive rename/alias/remove. Launched out-of-process via /sess ui. Full requirements in docs/SESSION_MANAGER_PANE_PRD.md.

userStories.title: Extract buildSessionDashboard selector
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want the /sess dashboard shape produced by a pure selector so the text formatter and the Ink pane share one source of truth.
acceptanceCriteria: New exported function buildSessionDashboard(routing, snapshots, currentSessionPath) in session-routing.ts returns { current, ready, storePath, sessions: [{ name, path, current, ready, activity, aliases }] }
activity is one of 'busy', 'idle', 'saved' per docs/SESSION_MANAGER_SPEC.qmd §Activity model
formatSessionManagerSummary refactored to consume buildSessionDashboard; existing text output unchanged
tests/session-routing.test.mjs adds at least 2 new cases covering busy, idle, and saved activity resolution
Existing tests in tests/session-routing.test.mjs continue to pass
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: buildSessionDashboard selector added in session-routing.ts; formatSessionManagerSummary refactored to wrap it; 3 new tests cover busy/idle/saved and unnamed-current projection.

userStories.title: Add session-events append log module
userStories.description: As the extension, I want an append-only event log so the pane can tail voice-triggered mutations without IPC.
acceptanceCriteria: New file session-events.ts exports appendSessionEvent(kind, payload) and tailSessionEvents(sinceOffset) returning { events, nextOffset }
Events stored at .pi-speak/session-events.jsonl beside the routing store path from getSessionRoutingStorePath
Log rotates to keep last 200 lines
Each event line is valid JSON with fields { ts, kind, source, payload }
New tests/session-events.test.mjs covers append, tail-from-offset, and rotation at boundary
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: session-events.ts exports appendSessionEvent(kind, source, payload) + tailSessionEvents(sinceOffset); stored at dirname(getSessionRoutingStorePath())/session-events.jsonl; 200-line bounded rotation; 4 new tests cover append shape, tail-from-offset, rotation at boundary, and stale-offset reset.

userStories.title: Emit session events from voice-originated mutations
userStories.description: As an operator, I want voice-triggered session changes to leave a trace in the event log so the pane can surface toasts.
acceptanceCriteria: index.ts calls appendSessionEvent at every /sess mutation path: new, switch, rename, remove confirmation, alias add, alias remove, wake set, wake clear, name
Events carry source='voice' when invoked via parseVoiceSlashCommand / parseVoiceBridgePrompt, else source='command'
Payload includes session name or path and alias where relevant
tests/session-command-integration.test.mjs adds at least 2 new cases asserting an event is emitted for a voice rename and a voice wake-alias set
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: /sess handler refactored into handleSessCommand(args, ctx, source); internal _sessVoice command registered for voice dispatch; routeVoiceInput now delegates voice-parsed /sess commands through handleSessCommand with source='voice'; appendSessionEvent fires for new, switch, rename, remove, name, alias.add, alias.remove across both top-level and edit-proxied paths; 3 new integration tests cover voice rename, voice wake-alias set, and typed rename (command source).

userStories.title: Add Ink build toolchain and admin CLI stub
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a separate UI build and a runnable bin entry so the Ink pane compiles without disturbing the main build.
acceptanceCriteria: package.json adds dependencies: ink, react, and devDependency @types/react pinned within Ink's peer-deps range
New tsconfig.ui.json with jsx='react' compiling ui/**/*.tsx to dist/ui/
package.json adds script build:ui running the UI tsconfig and an npm bin pi-speak-admin pointing to dist/ui/admin.js
ui/admin.tsx is a stub that prints usage when --help is passed and exits 0
npm run build still passes (main project typecheck unchanged)
npm run build:ui passes
Running node dist/ui/admin.js --help prints a short usage string
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Installed ink@^7.0.0 + react@^19.2.5 as deps and @types/react@^19.2.14 as devDep (Ink v7 peer-deps require React >=19.2). Added tsconfig.ui.json with jsx='react', outDir=dist/ui, rootDir=ui, include=ui/**/*.{ts,tsx}. package.json gains script build:ui and bin pi-speak-admin->dist/ui/admin.js. ui/admin.tsx is a stub with shebang that prints usage on --help (exit 0) and a 'stub' message otherwise. Main tsconfig still uses include:['*.ts'] so UI files are not picked up by the main build.

Rendered layout matches the example in docs/SESSION_MANAGER_PANE_PRD.md §UX §Dashboard

userStories.title: Live polling hook and toast component
userStories.description: As an operator, I want the pane to refresh within 1s of external store changes and show toast feedback when voice events arrive.
acceptanceCriteria: ui/hooks/useSessionStore.ts polls routing-store mtime every 500ms and reloads when it changes

ui/components/Toast.tsx renders a single-line band at the bottom with 'voice: ...' or 'admin: ...' prefix
tests/ui-polling.test.mjs covers: store mutation detected within one poll interval, event tail returns only new events since last offset, toast TTL expires

userStories.title: Pane write actions: rename, alias, remove
userStories.description: As an operator, I want keybindings r/a/x in the pane to mutate sessions so I do not have to type slash commands.
acceptanceCriteria: ui/components/ActionBar.tsx shows keybindings [r] rename  [a] alias  [x] remove  [q] quit

userStories.title: Extension-side reload on external store change
userStories.description: As an operator, I want pane-triggered mutations to reflect in /sess text output without restarting the extension.
acceptanceCriteria: index.ts watches the routing-store path; on external mtime bump it calls loadPersistedSessionRouting and updates SESSION_REGISTRY_TYPE and SESSION_WAKE_ALIAS_TYPE state maps
Watcher skips reloads triggered by its own writes (track last write mtime)

No regression in existing session-command-integration tests

userStories.title: /sess ui launcher
userStories.description: As an operator, I want /sess ui to open the pane in a second terminal so it does not fight pi-coding-agent for the TTY.
acceptanceCriteria: /sess ui in index.ts spawns dist/ui/admin.js detached in a new terminal using 'start' on Windows
If no terminal emulator is detected, the handler notifies the exact command the operator can run manually
The spawned process does not inherit stdin/stdout/stderr from the pi-coding-agent process
A new test mocks child_process.spawn and asserts the command, args, and detached flag
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
Manual terminal verification: running /sess ui opens a new Windows terminal running the admin CLI
